logline: From green beans washed in morning light to the third blessing cup, the Ethiopian coffee ceremony gathers a family across generations.
audience: Ethiopian families at home and in the diaspora watching on mobile and desktop
intent: To evoke the unhurried warmth, aroma, and community bond of the traditional Ethiopian buna ceremony
music_style: warm Ethiopian acoustic krar, gentle washint flute, soft ambient strings, 76 BPM, instrumental
style_block: cinematic documentary, golden hour warm sunlight, 35mm film grain, Ethiopian highland earth tones, shallow depth of field
end_card_text: Made with AI · Heritage Film Studio

shots.description: Wide shot of fresh green grass scattered across a traditional Ethiopian living room floor at morning.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of fresh green ketema grass scattered on a warm earthen floor in a traditional Ethiopian home, morning sunlight streaming through a wooden window
shots.motion_prompt: slow push in over the green grass, gentle dust motes in sunlight
shots.narration_text: በኢትዮጵያ ቤት ውስጥ ጠዋት በለምለም ቄጠማ ሲነጠፍ የቡና ሥነ ሥርዓት ይጀምራል።
shots.narration_en: In an Ethiopian home, the coffee ceremony begins as fresh green grass is spread across the floor.
shots.reason: Establishes setting, ritual hospitality, and morning light

shots.description: Close-up of hands washing raw green Ethiopian coffee beans in a shallow bowl of clear water.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of an Ethiopian woman's hands washing green coffee beans in clear water inside a handmade clay bowl, warm golden light
shots.motion_prompt: slow downward tilt toward the water ripples
shots.narration_text: አረንጓዴው የቡና ፍሬ በንጹሕ ውኃ ታጥቦ በትዕግሥት ይዘጋጃል።
shots.narration_en: Green coffee beans are washed in clear water and prepared with quiet patience.
shots.reason: Shows care and tactile preparation before roasting

shots.description: Medium close-up of coffee beans roasting on a flat black iron mitad pan over glowing charcoal.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of dark glistening coffee beans roasting on a traditional black iron mitad pan over glowing red charcoal embers, wispy smoke rising
shots.motion_prompt: locked-off static frame, gentle smoke curling upward
shots.narration_text: በሚነድ ከሰል ላይ ሲቆላ መዓዛው መላውን ቤት ይሞላዋል።
shots.narration_en: Roasted over glowing embers, their rich aroma soon fills every corner of the house.
shots.reason: Captures the sensory turning point of the ceremony

shots.description: Medium shot of a mother in a white netela shawl wafting fragrant coffee smoke toward elders and children.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of an Ethiopian mother in a white cotton netela shawl gently wafting aromatic smoke from a roasting pan toward smiling family members
shots.motion_prompt: slow lateral tracking shot from pan to family faces
shots.narration_text: እናቴ የቡናውን ጢስ ወደ ቤተሰቡ ስታዞር ፍቅርና ሰላም ይሰማል።
shots.narration_en: As my mother wafts the fragrant smoke toward the family, warmth and peace settle over everyone.
shots.reason: Connects the ritual action to family affection

shots.description: Close-up of a wooden mukecha mortar and pestle grinding roasted beans by hand.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a traditional carved wooden mukecha mortar and pestle crushing freshly roasted dark coffee beans in warm golden light
shots.motion_prompt: slow push in on the rhythmic wooden pestle
shots.narration_text: በሙቀጫ ሲወቀጥ እያንዳንዱ ምት የቀድሞ ትውስታን ይቀሰቅሳል።
shots.narration_en: Pounded by hand in the wooden mortar, every beat awakens old family memories.
shots.reason: Bridges physical craft with ancestral memory

shots.description: Close-up of a black clay jebena pot simmering beside glowing embers with frankincense smoke.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a traditional black clay Ethiopian jebena coffee pot beside a glowing frankincense burner on a woven tray, warm golden light
shots.motion_prompt: slow vertical tilt from embers up the neck of the jebena
shots.narration_text: ጥቁሯ ጀበና በእሳቱ ዳር ስትፈላ የዕጣኑ ጢስ ወደ ላይ ይወጣል።
shots.narration_en: While the black clay jebena simmers by the fire, frankincense smoke rises softly.
shots.reason: Highlights the iconic jebena vessel and sacred stillness

shots.description: Close-up of dark coffee pouring cleanly from the jebena spout into small handleless cini cups.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of rich dark Ethiopian coffee pouring in a steady stream from a black clay jebena spout into small white porcelain cini cups on a wooden tray
shots.motion_prompt: slow push in on the rising steam over the cups
shots.narration_text: አቦል፣ ቶናና በረካ ሲቀዱ ጎረቤትና ዘመድ በአንድ ማዕድ ይሰበሰባሉ።
shots.narration_en: As Abol, Tona, and Bereka are poured, neighbors and kin gather around one table.
shots.reason: Names the three traditional rounds and community bond

shots.description: Wide shot of three generations smiling together over small cini cups in warm evening light.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of three generations of an Ethiopian family sitting together smiling over small white coffee cups in warm golden evening light
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull back revealing the warm room
shots.narration_text: ቡና ከመጠጥ በላይ የትውልዶች ድልድይና የሕይወታችን ቅርስ ነው።
shots.narration_en: More than a drink, Ethiopian coffee is a bridge across generations and our living heritage.
shots.reason: Delivers emotional resolution and heritage theme
